title: Virtual Card Management: Revoking and Canceling Virtual Cards
summary: Explains how to manage virtual cards in Cards > Virtual by either revoking (immediately disables the card and blocks new authorizations) or canceling (permanently closes the card). Revocation and cancellation both take effect within 3 seconds, with post-action checks to ensure new authorizations decline and saved payment profiles are updated.
